source: Generated by scripts/fetch-fb-spend.mjs (Facebook Marketing API, account-level insights). Each run pulls the last 10 months (9 full months back + month-to-date) and merges them into whatever was already on disk — older months outside that window are preserved from the previous run, not dropped, so history doesn't shrink as the rolling window moves forward. 'nose_open' = Nose Open 01 + 02 + the Freelance Nett account (221741759556998, added 2026-08-26 after the team flagged it was missing — checked its full campaign list and none are named "Inter", so its entire spend is pure nose_open). 'inter' = the dedicated Inter account (1711014813661620, renamed from Nose Open 03 on 2026-08-06) plus any campaigns still named "Inter" inside Nose Open 02 from before that reorg. 'total' = all 6 accounts in ACCOUNTS below (nose_open x3 + semi + breast + brow) + the dedicated Inter account, 7 accounts total — not the sum of the category fields, which would double-count the legacy Inter campaigns already inside nose_open.
